# Cleveland Clinic MyChart & Professional Resources

> > Cleveland Clinic's professional portal for medical education, research collaboration, cancer care, gastroenterology resources, and caregiver support programs.

This portal serves healthcare professionals, researchers, students, and caregivers with access to clinical resources, CME education, biospecimen research, career opportunities, and patient education materials. Key programs include VeloSano cancer research funding, Catalyst Grants for caregivers, and specialized institutes like the Digestive Disease & Surgery Institute and Cleveland Clinic Cancer Center.

## Key Topics

- Cleveland Clinic Cancer Center
- Digestive Disease & Surgery Institute
- Medical professional resources
- CME education and fellowships
- Gastroenterology and colorectal cancer
- Oncology careers and cancer care jobs
- VeloSano and cancer research funding
- Catalyst Grants for caregivers
- BioRepository and biospecimen access
- Consult QD clinical news
- Physician referral programs
- Healthcare partnerships
- Body donation program
- Youth medical education programs
- Cancer Answer Line

## Medical Professional Resources

- [For Gastroenterology Medical Professionals](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/digestive/medical-professionals): Gastroenterology resources for medical professionals: referrals & CME

## Research & Biospecimen Services

- [Biospecimen Access Guidelines](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/biorepository/about/biospecimen-access-guidelines): BioRepository governance policy and biospecimen access requirements

## Patient Education & Awareness

- [Colorectal Cancer Awareness Month](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/digestive/patient-education/colorectal-cancer-awareness): Colorectal cancer prevention resources and screening information
- [Why Donate Your Body](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/body-donation/why-donate): Whole body donation benefits for medical education and research

## Education & Career Development

- [Center for Youth and College Education](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/education/center-for-youth-and-college-education): CYCE youth programs: internships, shadowing, and career exploration
- [Cancer Careers: Cancer Care Jobs](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/cancer/medical-professionals/careers): Cancer care job opportunities at Cleveland Clinic Cancer Center

## Caregiver Support

- [Apply for a Caregiver Grant](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/caregiver-grants-apply): Catalyst Grant application for Cleveland Clinic caregiver funding

## Optional

- [Corporate Compliance and Business Ethics](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/about/overview/who-we-are/employee-notice): Corporate Compliance Program, Code of Conduct, and reporting hotline
- [Reprints & Licensing](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/about/website/reprints-licensing): Content reprints, licensing policy, and copyright permissions
